_meta: Reader on-screen status / diagnostics: snapshot.status is refreshed on every poll tick, no registry involved. Keys keep the ui.reader.* prefix until the rename batch. reframework.* holds the REFramework installer diagnostics produced by rise_reframework_manager.cpp / reframework_fetcher.cpp and shown through rise_reframework_bridge.cpp.
